utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Okay, we're short on time today. Hamburg booth first.

utterances.text: Yeah, so, the stand builder came back yesterday and, um, they want final artwork by the ninth now, not the fourteenth.

utterances.text: Why?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Their printer's moved or something, I didn't totally follow it, the guy was calling from a car.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think maybe we could make the ninth? I'd have to check with design, they might be-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Check today.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yeah. Yeah, will do.

utterances.text: Do we even need new artwork? It's the same product line as Lyon back in June.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: May. And the logo changed, Kofi.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Only slightly.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Legal doesn't do slightly.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: New artwork. Next. Expense tool.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Cutover's the first of October.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: What do we need to do?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Get September claims in by the twenty-sixth.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Is that a Friday?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Oh god, I've got like four months of taxi receipts in a shoebox, I mean literally a shoebox, it's under the printer, and half of them have gone that faded grey colour where you can't read the-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sofia.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Sorry. Twenty-sixth. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Finance also wants the Q4 webinar number. Tariq?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think it's around eleven thousand? Maybe eleven two with the platform fee, but I'd want to double check that.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Send it by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Sure, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Is that with the captioning or without?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Um, without, I think. Maybe. I'll look.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Right. Summit. Budget planning opens in three weeks and I've got nothing on paper for next year. What have we got?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: So, okay, this has been rattling around since the debrief. What if there just isn't a central one next year, and instead it's three one-day regional roadshows, Manchester, Frankfurt and Austin?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Three.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Three. One day each, more or less the same content.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Why?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Because look at last year. We put 180,000 dollars into customer travel subsidies and only 34 percent of target accounts actually turned up.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Whereas with those three cities most of them are a short trip away, a train or a quick hop, not a whole week gone out of the office.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay, but hang on, is that a distance problem? Maybe they just didn't fancy coming.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Some of them, sure, but I went through the decline emails after the debrief and it's, you know, can't get the trip approved, over and over.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: How many is over and over?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I didn't count, I just-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Because three emails from Ohio isn't a trend.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It was a lot more than three.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Count them.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Yep. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think, um, maybe that subsidy line drops a lot with it? Like if they're on a train there's not much to subsidise. But I'd be guessing.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sure, that one drops, but then you've got three venues, three AV crews, three of everything. The money doesn't vanish, it just moves.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Does it?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Possibly? I think maybe one day in a hotel ballroom isn't that bad, but I haven't priced any of it, so.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And there's five of us. Who's carrying boxes to Austin?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Well, we'd space them out, it's not like they'd be back to back, and a one-day thing is honestly so much lighter than-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Lighter times three, though.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Okay, lighter times three, but still.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And the execs. Getting the CEO to all of those?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Last year she stayed forty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Ha. Okay. Fair.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Oh, and that reminds me, the lanyards, did I ever tell you what actually happened with the lanyards?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Is this relevant?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It's a little bit relevant. So the courier sends the box to the wrong Hartwell, right, the airport one, and I'm on the phone to this lovely man called Gerald-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: There's always a Gerald.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: There is, and Gerald says he can see the box, he's looking at it, but he can't release it without a form from the sender, and the sender's closed because it's a Sunday in, um, in wherever they are-

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Wasn't it you who drove out there in the end?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: That was Priya, she took her husband's van, and she came back with twelve hundred lanyards and a parking ticket, and we're still arguing with finance about that ticket, I think it's in the shoebox actually.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: It is not in the expense policy.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It is not, no, thank you, Ingrid.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Back to it. Kofi, what else?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: The room. Half the point of getting everyone together is customers meeting other customers. A German bank doesn't meet the guy from Texas if they're never in one place.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Do they want to, though?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Some do. The user group people do, they talk about it all year.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think that's maybe fair, but, I mean, a third of the accounts isn't much of a big room either.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: A third's still a room.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: A very expensive room.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Frankfurt would need its own registration notice. German wording, data handling, that sort of thing.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Hard?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: No. Two weeks with legal, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine. Tariq, where are you on it?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think I'm probably for it? As long as, you know, the costs don't come back ugly. It seems like it gets in front of more of the people we actually care about.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Ingrid?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: For it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Kofi, are you actually against this?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Not really. I just think somebody should be.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: That's the nicest thing you've ever said about one of my ideas.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Don't get used to it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Right. That's it, then. Next year's summit runs as the three regional roadshows, Manchester, Frankfurt, Austin.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Yes. Okay. Great.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tariq, rough costs for it before planning opens.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yep. I think maybe a first pass by the end of next week? It'll be rough.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Rough is fine. Sofia, those emails.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Counting them, yes.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Ingrid, have a word with legal about that notice.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Do I get anything?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: You get the holiday party.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: That's a punishment.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yes. Facilities need a headcount by mid-October.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Is it the same place as last year? Because the coat check there was a disaster, I was in that queue for, I swear, forty-five minutes, and-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'll find out.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think maybe somebody said they'd closed down? Or was that the other one, the one near the station.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: The other one, I think.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Also the desk move. We're on the third floor from the sixth of October, pack by the Friday before.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Crates arrive when?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Monday before, supposedly.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Supposedly, right. Gerald's probably delivering them.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: To the wrong Hartwell.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tariq, Hamburg artwork. Today.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. Doing it now, actually, I'll just-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Good. We're done.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Crates. Who's got theirs?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I've got, um, one, I was told two, and it's got somebody else's name on it, a Martin, do we have a Martin?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Facilities has a Martin.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: So I've got Martin's crate. Great. And he's presumably got, I don't know, nothing, or mine-

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Mine came.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think mine might be, um, by the lifts? There's a stack there, but I didn't want to, you know, take one that wasn't-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Take one. Packed by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. Okay. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Hamburg. Did the artwork go?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: It did, yeah, well, it- design sent it yesterday. I think the builder's got it. They, um, they acknowledged something.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Something.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: There was a thumbs up. On the email thread. I can get a proper confirmation, maybe.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Get one.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: A thumbs up from the man in the car.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: That's the most we've ever had from him, honestly, last time it was just a voice note and you could hear the indicator going the whole-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Expense tool. Tomorrow, yes?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Tomorrow. Old one locks at six tonight.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Six? I thought it was- okay, no, I got mine in. Mostly. On the Friday. The shoebox is empty, I want that noted.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Noted. Mostly.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Anything not in by six goes through the new one.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Good. Webinar number went to finance?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yeah, I think it was eleven two in the end, and the captioning's, um, on top. So maybe a bit more. I did flag that.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: So I was right to ask.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: You were, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine. Summit. Planning opens in, what, two weeks? Three? Where's it at?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Two and a bit.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: So the costs, I've, uh, I've started it, it's- I said end of this week and I think that's still maybe okay, but it's very rough, I've got hotel-type numbers for two of them, and-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yeah, before you get into that. You copied me on the venue stuff, didn't you? And I've had the registration inbox open since Friday, because somebody had to.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Oh, is it good? How's it looking? I've been dying to-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Well. It's not nothing. Hang on, I've got it here.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Of the hundred and forty target accounts we sent that save-the-date to, fifty-eight have come back with a yes. That's as of this morning.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And the Frankfurt place sent a new quote yesterday. It's twenty-two percent up on what they gave Tariq.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Twenty-two?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Oh. I, um, I hadn't actually opened that one yet. I saw it come in, I just thought it was the, uh, the contract thing.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Why up?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Trade fair the same month, apparently. Everything in town goes up, or that's their story.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think maybe that's- is it negotiable? They might just be, you know, opening high.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Might be. It's in writing, though.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Okay, but fifty-eight, hang on, that's- it's been out, what, a few days? That's not bad. For a few days. That's already, like, forty percent, and last year we only got thirty-four, so-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Last year's thirty-four is people who walked through the door.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Well, sure, but-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: This is people clicking yes on a date. For free. Doesn't cost anything to click it.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Right, no, I know, but it's early, is what I'm saying, people are at their desks, half of them haven't even- the Americans probably haven't looked at it.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: How many of the yeses are Austin?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I don't- do you know?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Haven't split it. It's one save-the-date, it just asked if they'd be interested in attending one.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think we'd maybe want that split. Before, um, before anyone reads too much into it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sofia. The emails.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Yes. So I'm, um, I'm most of the way through, it's definitely more than three, Kofi, I'll say that much. There's a whole folder from March I'd forgotten about.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'll wait.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: End of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: End of the week, yep.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I mean, on the Frankfurt thing, I think if it's just the one line, maybe it doesn't move the total that much? It's one of three. But I'd have to- I haven't got the AV in yet, so.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Can I say something.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Go on.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: What's it measured on?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: The summit? Well, attendance, sort of, and the-

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Pipeline. One point two million dollars.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: That number doesn't care how many cities we went to. Fifty-eight soft yeses out of a hundred and forty, and Frankfurt costing more before we've signed anything. I don't see how that gets us to one point two. These roadshows could miss it.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Oh. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: That's all.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I mean, it's- nobody's said it can't, though? It's one week of replies, that's-

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: No. It's what we've got, though.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think she's maybe got a point. Like, I said I was for it as long as the costs didn't come back ugly, and I don't know yet that they're ugly, but it's, um, it's a bit less pretty than it was.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Look at this. I don't even have to do it myself.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Kofi, is she right?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Honestly? Don't know. I'd want to know what the pipeline per account was last time, and I don't think anyone's ever-

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Marketing has that. Somewhere. I think. Or- no, they had it for the year before, there was that dashboard that broke, the one with the-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Who owns that number?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Sales ops, I think.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: And it's not like one big room was hitting it by magic, is it? I mean, did we hit it last year? With the thirty-four percent?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Different question.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It's not, though, is it, it's kind of the same-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: It is if we don't know the answer.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Enough. We don't have the numbers to have this properly.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think maybe if I get the costs done, and, um, the Frankfurt quote in there, at the higher figure, that at least-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yes. Higher figure.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yep. Will do.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nothing's changed today. It's still the three roadshows until somebody shows me otherwise. But I've heard you, Ingrid.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Don't go telling sales it's wobbling.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I wouldn't. Well, I'd- no. I wouldn't.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: She would.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Once. I did that once, Kofi.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Holiday party. Kofi.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Same venue's still open, so that was the other one that closed, Tariq was half right. They want a headcount by the fifteenth.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Oh, good. Well, not good for the other one, but-

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: And the coat check? Because if it's the same people I'm bringing my coat to the table and I don't care who-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I asked. They said they've "looked at the process."

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Is the fifteenth a Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine. Third floor Monday. Laptops stay with you, don't crate them.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Does anyone know who's next to who? Because if I'm by the kitchen again I'm going to hear about everybody's lunch, and-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: No idea. Tariq, Hamburg confirmation, today.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. Right now, I think. I'll just-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: We're done.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Everyone found their desks?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I found mine, it's by the kitchen, of course it's by the kitchen, somebody had fish in the microwave at ten past nine.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: That was me.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It was not.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: No. Could've been, though.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: My crate's still on six.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tell facilities.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: I did. Martin's looking.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: So he does exist! Did he ever get his crate, because I've still got it, and it's got all my stuff in it now, and-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Give it back. Hamburg.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes, so, the builder did confirm, properly this time, an actual email. I think it's all fine. They want a name for the on-site contact by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yours.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Okay. Yes. I thought maybe it might be.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Did the man in the car write it?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: His assistant, I think. It had full sentences.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Shame.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Expense tool. Working?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Mostly. Mileage is broken.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I couldn't even log in yesterday, it kept asking me for a cost centre, and I've been here six years and I've honestly no idea what ours is, I just put-

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Four one seven.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Thank you, Ingrid.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Right. Summit. You've all had a week with Kofi's numbers, so I'm opening it back up. Is the format right or isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Well, there you go.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Oh. Okay. Yeah. No, fine, okay.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tariq, costs went round?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Friday, yeah. Friday night, sorry. The AV quotes came in, so I think everything's there now, and Frankfurt's at the higher figure, like you said.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sofia. Emails.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Done. Sixty-three, Kofi. Sixty-three separate people saying they couldn't get the trip signed off, and that's not counting the ones who just wrote "budget" and nothing else.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay. More than three.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Thank you. I'd like that minuted.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Doesn't fix the rest of it, mind. I split those yeses by account over the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Thirty-nine are UK or Europe. Nineteen are North America.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: So Austin's maybe a little thin? I think. I mean, depending on how you-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Thin's a kind word for it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Has the total moved?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: No. Same fifty-eight out of a hundred and forty. It came in fast and then it just stopped.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Well, it's been a-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: A free click, still, that's all it is. And that's as good as it's got after two weeks, near enough.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: And I think, um, Kofi's thing about the pipeline is probably the bigger worry, the one point two-

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: That was me.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Sorry, yes. Ingrid's thing.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'd have happily taken it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sales ops come back?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Not yet. They said Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So replies have stalled, Frankfurt's up, and nobody can connect it to the target. Sofia, this was yours. Answer it.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Okay. So the replies. That save-the-date went out before a single executive invitation did, and last year it was the executive invitations that tripled responses.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: And the money, even with the Frankfurt increase sitting in there, Tariq's sheet has the roadshows coming in 61,000 dollars under the central event.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Tripled. Says who?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Says the registration log, it's in the debrief, you can literally see the week they landed, it goes from this sad little line to-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Three times fifty-eight's a hundred and seventy-four. We only wrote to a hundred and forty.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I know that, I can multiply, I'm not saying it triples. I'm saying you're marking the thing before the part that moves it has even gone out.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Hm.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I mean, I think that's maybe fair? It's a bit early to, um-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Last year's invite was for one big event with the CEO on stage, though. Who's signing three of them?

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Same person. Same signature. It's a mail merge, Kofi, she doesn't have to hold a pen.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Forty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Ha. Yes. There's that.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: That was one time, and she was there, which is the point of the invitation, it doesn't matter if she stayed for the coffee.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tariq. The sixty-one. Is it solid?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I think so? It's venues, AV, catering, our own travel. And the central number is last year's actuals, with, um, the subsidy line still in it.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. Which is honestly most of why it comes out that way. If that line weren't in there, I think it'd probably go the other way, but-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: So one line's doing all the work.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It's the line that bought us thirty-four percent! That's the whole reason we're here, it's not some accident in the spreadsheet-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'm just saying what's holding it up.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: And I'm saying it's holding it up because it was a bad way to spend 180,000 dollars.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tariq, Frankfurt. Did you push back?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I asked if there was any give. They've, uh, they've not replied. I think the trade fair thing might be real, I looked, there's a big one that month.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: So it could go up again.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: It could, maybe. Though it's a written quote, and I've got about eight percent contingency on the whole sheet.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Eight's not a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: No. I wouldn't call it a lot.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Ingrid. The notice?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: With legal. Draft back Friday.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Anything in it that hurts us?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: It still doesn't get me to one point two, though. Any of this.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: No, I know, and I can't give you that, nobody can till sales ops come back. But, I mean, we don't know the big room got there either, do we?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: No. We don't.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: So we're comparing a number we haven't got with a number we haven't got.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Pretty much, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Great. Love this job.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Kofi. Anything here that actually kills it?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Kills it? No. I've got a thin Austin and a saving that leans on one line. I'd keep an eye on both. Nothing fatal.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Tariq?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: I said as long as the costs didn't come back ugly, and I think they're, um, not ugly. Maybe a bit plain. I'm still fine with it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Ingrid?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: You know what I think. I've no number to put against it yet.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Heard. The planning submission says three regional roadshows, Manchester, Frankfurt, Austin. Tariq, tidy the sheet for it.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. Yep. By Friday, I think, if that's-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Okay. Good. I'm going to breathe now.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Don't look so pleased, you've still got Austin.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I love Austin.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Ingrid, chase sales ops Thursday. I still want that per-account figure.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Don't tell them why.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Don't look at me.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Everybody's looking at you.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Holiday party. Headcount.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Next Wednesday, the fifteenth. I've got thirty-one so far and about half the building hasn't answered.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Is that with partners or, um, without? I think last year it was maybe-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Without. Partners weren't invited last year either.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Wait, weren't they? Because I definitely remember somebody's husband at the coat check, a very tall man, he was holding about nine coats-

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: That was the venue manager.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Oh. That does explain the nine coats.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Webinar. Did finance query the captioning?

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Not yet. I think they might just pay it. I flagged it, anyway, so, you know.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine. Who's still got a laptop charger in a crate?

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Me.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Probably me, in Martin's crate, I haven't opened that end of it yet.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Sort it. Tariq, on-site name to the builder today.

utterances.speaker: Tariq
utterances.text: Yes. I'll just-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: We're done.
